events.title: Packers at Rams
events.subtitle: Wed Nov 25, 7:15 PM CT · Netflix
events.headline: Packers draw 54.8% of X buzz after Micah Parsons returns and Rams lose Puka Nacua, while Kalshi holds LA as 55.5% favorite.
story_bullets: Green Bay activated Micah Parsons for Wednesday night, while LA ruled out Puka Nacua (knee) and TE Terrance Ferguson (ankle).
Matt LaFleur is 5-0 vs. Sean McVay, yet Kalshi's Rams share stays above 55% even as Packers contracts make up nearly 80% of market volume.
Netflix broadcasts the game with a U2 halftime show, creating a prime live-watch cultural moment.
events.activation_angle: Run a 'Health vs. History' live prediction prop during Netflix's U2 halftime show. Packers fans dominate X chatter and contract flow, so a live second-half market booth or watch-party challenge in Chicago/Milwaukee taps huge Midwest demand.

events.title: Bears at Lions
events.subtitle: Thu Nov 26, 12:00 PM CT · CBS · Wu-Tang Halftime
events.headline: Both NFC North leaders enter 8-2. Bears own 58.7% of 7-day X volume (17,825 posts), while Lions fans lean slightly louder in pick threads.
story_bullets: Highest-buzz matchup on the Thanksgiving slate: 30,388 combined X posts across both teams in 7 days.
Kalshi prices Chicago at 55.5% (Bears -2.5 on the road), tracking closely with Chicago's 58.7% X buzz share.
Detroit's #OnePride fanbase floods reply threads on the 92nd anniversary of the 1934 Bears-Lions Thanksgiving game, with Wu-Tang Clan headlining halftime.
events.activation_angle: Chicago hometown opportunity: host a Thanksgiving midday Bears vs. Lions watch party with Vinyl Collectiv-style culture programming (tying into the Wu-Tang halftime show) and live NFC North odds boards.

events.title: Eagles at Cowboys
events.subtitle: Thu Nov 26, 3:30 PM CT · FOX · Miranda Lambert Halftime
events.headline: Kalshi prices Dallas at 79.5% against a slumping Philadelphia squad, but X buzz is split 45/55 as fans remain skeptical of 5-6 Dallas.
story_bullets: Big gap between market certainty (Dallas ~80%) and X skepticism: fans openly doubt Dallas can string wins together despite Dak Prescott's record chase.
Eagles fanbase remains active on X (7,282 weekly posts) even with Philly struggling, creating asymmetric contrarian conversation.
Miranda Lambert headlines the 30th Salvation Army Red Kettle Kickoff halftime show alongside Lauren Daigle on the anthem.
events.activation_angle: Classic 'Skeptical Crowd vs. Heavy Favorite' setup. Brands activating on the afternoon FOX window can lean into live in-game momentum props (will Dallas hold the lead?) rather than pre-game winner hype.

events.title: Timberwolves at Thunder
events.subtitle: Wed Nov 25, 6:30 PM CT · Paycom Center
events.headline: Kalshi prices OKC as a razor-thin 50.5% coin flip, while X pick sentiment swings heavily toward 13-5 Minnesota despite OKC holding higher total mention volume.
story_bullets: Minnesota enters 13-5 (even missing Anthony Edwards), while 10-8 OKC just dropped a 125-120 loss to Indiana despite Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's 38 points.
Fans in NBA Cup reply threads push back hard on OKC being favored, yet national SGA/OKC chatter drives 57.6% of total 7-day X volume.
Grassroots proof point: Minneapolis fans organized 'Wolvesgiving', a Nov 25 watch party and vendor market at Fowling Warehouse around this exact game.
events.activation_angle: Local fan markets like 'Wolvesgiving' show how NBA Cup nights already spawn IRL watch parties. Kalshi can co-sponsor fan-organized cup watch parties with custom group-stage probability boards.

events.title: Texas at Texas A&M
events.subtitle: Fri Nov 27, 6:30 PM CT · Kyle Field
events.headline: Tightest market-crowd alignment on the board: Kalshi puts Texas at 80.5% and X buzz runs 79.7% Longhorns (8,615 vs. 2,191 posts).
story_bullets: 9-2 Texas enters off a 45-3 rout with Arch Manning rolling, while 4-7 A&M faces a QB shakeup between Marcel Reed and Brady Hart.
Even with massive consensus on Texas, viral Aggie underdog stunts (like the '12th Cran' cranberry sauce bet with 64k+ views) drive high engagement.
Benchmark control event: when the favorite is dominant on both the field and the timeline, X buzz share tracks Kalshi within ~1 percentage point.
events.activation_angle: When odds are lopsided (80/20), pre-game winner polls are dull. Activate around rivalry fan stunts, over/under margin props, and tailgate challenges in College Station.

events.title: Michigan at Ohio State
events.subtitle: Sat Nov 28, 11:00 AM CT · Ohio Stadium
events.headline: LARGEST DIVERGENCE: Kalshi prices Ohio State at 77.5% (-10.5), yet X buzz (58.8% Michigan) and fan sentiment back the Wolverines after OSU's loss to Nebraska.
story_bullets: Ohio State lost 31-28 to Nebraska on Nov 21 (3 losses in 4 games) and hasn't beaten Michigan at home since 2018; Ryan Day sits 2-4 in the rivalry.
Even Ohio State fan accounts note Buckeye supporters picking Michigan on the timeline, creating a 35+ point gap between X crowd sentiment and Kalshi's 22.5% Michigan price.
Michigan upset No. 4 UCLA last weekend, fueling 'rivalry chaos' narratives all week across 19,849 combined X posts.
events.activation_angle: Flagship divergence activation: 'The Timeline vs. The Money.' Set up tailgate/campus activation content in Columbus and Big Ten watch bars asking fans why they doubt a 77.5% favorite.

events.title: 2026 NFL MVP Race
events.subtitle: Head-to-Head Focus: Brock Purdy vs. Joe Burrow
events.headline: Purdy just overtook Burrow on Kalshi (39.5c vs 36.5c; 52.0% H2H) after Burrow's MNF loss, yet X volume (57.9% Burrow) and MVP debate threads still lean heavily toward Burrow.
story_bullets: KalshiSports broke the flip on Nov 24 at 9:31 AM CT (135k+ views): Purdy surged ahead after 49ers hit 9-1 and Cincinnati fell 22-20 to Washington.
Bengals fans and neutral NFL accounts overwhelmingly argue Burrow is 'more valuable' to a weaker roster, keeping X sentiment ~64% Burrow in head-to-head debate.
Massive $50.1M contract volume ($868.5k in 24h) makes MVP the sharpest real-time narrative market on Kalshi.
events.activation_angle: Turn live QB prime-time performances into dynamic MVP ticker graphics for sports podcasts and creator partners; narrative lag between X sentiment and live market repricing creates instant debate fuel.

events.title: Oscars Best Picture
events.subtitle: The Odyssey vs. You Can See Everything & Dune: Part Three
events.headline: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey leads both Kalshi (52.5c; 61.4% H2H) and Film Twitter buzz (71.9% vs. Dune/YCSE), while Nathan Fielder's You Can See Everything is surging on Nov 24.
story_bullets: Market and Film Twitter agree on the frontrunner: Nolan's The Odyssey sits around 53% on Kalshi and tops critics' early Oscar ballots.
Fastest riser on X: A24's You Can See Everything (23.5c) grew from 43 daily posts a week ago to 157 posts on Nov 24, alongside Dune: Part Three (9.5c) teaser buzz.
Demonstrates how prediction markets quantify non-sports cultural momentum months before awards night.
events.activation_angle: Culture-first Kalshi activation: partner with indie theaters, film festivals, and awards podcasts (similar to a Miami Art Week / screening room activation) with live 'Best Picture Stock Exchange' boards.
